高考英语3500词 · 01英文原文

Fall in Love with English

爱上英语 · 177 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Hiding behind the loose, dusty curtain, a teenager packed his overcoat into a suitcase. He planned to leave home at dusk though there was thunder and lightning outdoors. He felt he had to do this because he was tired of his parents’ nagging about his English studies and did not want to go through it any longer. He struggled with English and disliked joining in during English class because he thought his teacher ignored him on purpose. As a result, he never scored more than 60 on any exam.

2His partner was very concerned about him. She understood exactly what he was suffering from, but entirely disagreed with his idea. In order to calm him down and help him solve his problem, she talked with him face to face and swapped a series of learning tips with him. The tips she wrote down helped him find a way to study English effectively.

3The teenager was grateful and drew great strength from his friend’s words. Now, he is no longer upset and has fallen in love with English.

高考英语3500词 · 01中文译文

爱上英语

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一个十几岁的男孩躲在松垂、积灰的窗帘后，把大衣塞进行李箱。外面雷电交加，他却打算在黄昏时离家出走。父母总为他的英语学习唠叨，他已经受够了，觉得自己非走不可。他学英语一直不顺利，也不爱参加英语课，因为他认定老师故意不理会他。结果，他每次考试的分数都没超过六十分。

2他的搭档很担心他。她知道他究竟在为什么事苦恼，却一点也不赞成他的打算。为了让他冷静下来，帮他解决问题，她和他当面聊了聊，还跟他交流了一些学习窍门。她记下的那些要点帮他找到了学好英语的门路。

3男孩很感激她，也从朋友的话里得到了很大的鼓舞。如今，他走出了那段低落的日子，爱上了英语。
